paragraphs.text: Star Trek (stylized as Magic: The Gathering® | Star Trek™ ) is an upcoming Magic: The Gathering expansion in the Universes Beyond series, based on the television franchise of the same name that celebrates its 60th anniversary. Created in collaboration with CBS , it is scheduled for release on November 13, 2026 and will feature characters and stories from the entire franchise. This 115th Standard expansion set was first announced at MagicCon Atlanta 2025. Elements of the set premiered at the 2026 STLV: Trek To Vegas convention (August 5–9, 2026), which was sponsored by Wizards of the Coast .

Star Trek is an American science fiction media franchise created by Gene Roddenberry , which began with the series of the same name and became a worldwide pop-culture phenomenon. Since its creation, the franchise has expanded into various films, television series, video games, novels, and comic books, and it has become one of the most recognizable and highest-grossing media franchises of all time.

The franchise began with Star Trek ( The Original Series ), which debuted on September 8, 1966, on NBC. The series followed the voyages of the crew of the starship USS Enterprise , a space exploration vessel built by the United Federation of Planets in the 23rd century, on a mission "to explore strange new worlds, to seek out new life and new civilizations, to boldly go where no man has gone before". In creating Star Trek, Roddenberry was inspired by C. S. Forester's Horatio Hornblower series of novels, Jonathan Swift's 1726 novel Gulliver's Travels , the 1956 film Forbidden Planet , and television westerns such as Wagon Train .

The Star Trek canon includes The Original Series , The Next Generation , Deep Space Nine , Voyager , multiple subsequent television series, and a film franchise; further adaptations also exist in expanded media. The Star Trek franchise is owned by Paramount , which controls both its film division ( Paramount Pictures ) and the television division ( CBS ).

The possibility of a partnership between Magic and Star Trek had been circulating in the community for over a year. In 2024, an image of an alleged test card for the sci-fi franchise was leaked, igniting discussions about a collaboration.

Although the similarly themed Edge of Eternities came out in 2025 , R&D was working on the two sets at the same time due to how timelines work for Universe Beyond sets. The design of the set encompasses all Star Trek shows and movies, and even the Kelvin timeline .
The main Standard -legal set uses the code TRK. Alternate card frames have a different card number than the original version.
The related Commander product code is TRC; these cards are legal in eternal-legal formats like Commander , Legacy , and Vintage .
The related bonus sheet code is SDS ( Stardates ), with the same legality as TRC.

Star Trek is sold in Play Boosters , Collector Boosters , and four Commander decks that also come in a Collector's Edition . In addition, there are the Star Trek Bundle , a "Beam Me Up" Bundle , a Draft Night Box, two Scene Boxes and five Welcome decks .
A Beginner Box was planned, but was canceled due to production and shipping delays. The Beginner Box had been designed by Chris Kvartek
Klingon language cards appear only in Collector Boosters.
Four preconstructed Commander decks are released alongside the main set.
Star Trek features five Welcome Decks .

The set features four sets of scene cards with the TRK expansion code, which are available as part of the set's Booster Fun . Two separately sold Scene Boxes ( Entreprise-Q and Divergent Timeline ) include three Play Boosters, six art cards , and a display easel.

Star Trek reuses Spacecraft and the associated Station mechanic from the similarly space-themed Edge of Eternities . A new mechanical spin on the Spacecraft in this set is that some have abilities that trigger whenever they're stationed, even if they've already passed all their station thresholds.

A new mechanic used in the set is Federation . Federation is an ability word signifying abilities that care about the number of non-Borg creature types among creatures you control. As for the Borg , their ability to assimilate organisms into their hive mind is represented by the new Assimilate keyword action . When you assimilate a creature card, you put it onto the battlefield under your control with a +1/+1 counter on it. It's a Borg artifact creature and loses all other creature types. Supporting this is also a theme of artifact creature typal.

Facing a dilemma is a new term codifying certain game actions, similar to committing a crime . You face a dilemma as you choose one or more modes for a spell or ability. The Star Trek series is defined by its moral choices and decisions, rather than warfare. To reflect this, there are many modal cards in the set.

Beam me up is a keyword ability on instants and sorceries that allows the player to pay an alternative cost to cast the spell from their graveyard . In addition to the mana cost listed, it also requires the player to return a creature they control to their owner's hand. The spell card is exiled when the spell leaves the stack .
Strange new worlds is an ability word used on cards that rely on and count the number of differently named lands a player controls.
Explore appears as a cameo mechanic.
The set introduces the Officer creature type to represent all Starfleet personnel.

The Star Trek series is characterized by the diversity of characters and species. To reflect this, there are no cards typed as Alien in the set, but all the different species have their own creature type instead. The set introduces Andorian , Borg , Caitian , Gorn , Kelpien , Klingon , Lanthanite , Orion , Q , Romulan , Talosian , Tellarite , Tholian , Tosk , Vorta , Vulcan and Xindi ; thus introducing the most new creature types since Mirage (which introduced 25 ).
As is the case with most Universes Beyond sets, Saga enchantments are used in the set to represent iconic Star Trek storylines. There are five uncommon and five rare Sagas in the main set.
Star Trek introduces promotion counters .

The Headliners for this set are seven signed autograph cards , textless versions of cards that appear in the set. Each depicts a character that fans will instantly recognize, rendered against a cosmic background. Beneath the portrait is an empty text box . Once printed, each card was hand-signed in that text box by the actor who originally portrayed the character and randomly inserted into a Collector Booster. There are approximately 250 copies of each signed card. Autograph cards can only appear in Collector Boosters of any language, but the card will always be in English.

Each Beam Me Up Bundle contains two of 2 of 8 Beam Me Up Bundle promo cards. Each of these cards is a Star Trek Spacecraft , depicted in the form of a schematic that outlines the ship's abilities.

Wizards of the Coast joined forces with Sirius , a New York producer of dice and tabletop accessories, to create a line of exclusive, premium dice for Magic: The Gathering | Star Trek . Headlining the catalogue are two 55mm crystal spindowns featuring either the U.S.S. Enterprise or the Klingon Bird-of-Prey ($54.99 each). A blind Treasure Pack ($7.99) comes with one of 25 possible oversize 25 mm spindown life counter d20s and either of of twenty acrylic MTG ( counter token sheets or one of six acrylic creature tokens . There are common, rare, and legendary rarity dice to track down. Last in the lineup are Star Trek faction-themed Mini Dice Cups. The Mini Dice Cups ($19.99) are randomized and each include two Magic counter dice. There are 10 total possible factions to collect, including a “legendary Q emblem” chase cup.

Another token set is released by Beadle & Grimm's . This consists of a USS Enterprise metal life counter (1–40), 5 +1/+1 counter (+5/+5 on the other side) designed as as various "Ships of the Line", four Borg -styled D6 counters, seven aluminum token cards ( Borg , Illusion , Klingon Warrior , Ninja , Ninja New Planet Officer , Porthos and Romulan ), all in an embossed tin with Star Trek art.
